title: Onboarding a new engineer
description: Day-one checklist. Most steps are description-only on purpose: an onboarding runbook is a procedure, not a script.

steps.title: Create the accounts
steps.description:
- Email
- SSO
- Password manager
- GitHub org invite

Ask the new hire to confirm each one before moving on.

steps.title: Prepare the laptop
steps.description: Install the bootstrap script and run it. Then check that `drill doctor` reports every shell as available (once it exists).

steps.title: Grant repository access
steps.description: Add to the team, then have them clone the repo and run `drill list` to make sure the runbooks folder is there.

steps.title: Ship a first small change
steps.description: Something real but small, reviewed by a teammate. This is the step that actually tells you the setup worked.

steps.title: Assign a buddy
steps.description: One named person for the first two weeks. Write the name in the ticket, not in this book.
